thread:
Maya: Quick sync — ACME pilot demands org SSO; sales says conditional on SSO. timeline tension.

Kevin: They will sign if we can deliver SSO for their tenant. Procurement wants delivery ~3 weeks.

Raj: Engineering estimate: complete SSO + audit logs ~4 weeks. Minimal tenant-scoped SSO + CSV export ~2 weeks.

Elaine: UX: magic-link + simple admin CSV export is fast. Full SSO needs extra screens (link accounts, admin consent).

Sara: Security: magic-link acceptable for pilot but we need documented audit retention and access controls. Legal will ask.

Maya: Proposal:

```
MVP (public launch):
- Magic-link tenant-scoped auth
- Admin CSV audit export (search + filters)
- Expose SSO (SAML/OIDC) as paid pilot integration scoped to single tenant

Pilot plan:
- If customer pays pilot fee, prioritize tenant SSO delivery within 3 weeks
- GA SSO to v1 after pilot validation
```

Kevin: Sales ok with pilot fee; I'll push for LOI with language: "Pilot SSO scoped to single tenant; GA timeline TBD; pilot SLA as agreed."

Raj: If pilot-paid, we can rotate an eng to SSO work; that delays Optimize perf backlog items by ~2 weeks.

Elaine: I'll wireframe magic-link flows and admin export today; can hand off to devs tomorrow.

Sara: I'll create a short compliance note for Legal highlighting retention, export access, and pilot constraints.

Maya: Quick reaction check — thumbs up to MVP escape-hatch + paid SSO pilot? React with :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown:

Elaine: :thumbsup:
Raj: :thumbsup:
Kevin: :thumbsup:
Sara: :thumbsup:

Maya: Consensus. Actions:
- Kevin: secure LOI/PO by EOD if ACME confirms
- Raj: draft 3-week pilot delivery plan and call out blockers
- Elaine: deliver magic-link + export mocks
- Sara: compliance note for Legal
- Maya: update roadmap entry and schedule 15m alignment tomorrow 10:30
